diagnostics.message: state "archived" of "status" cannot be reached from the initial state "draft" by any transition. Add the transition that leads there, or set verify.lifecycle.unreachable if only seeded data uses it.

the command derived from transition "submit" of "PurchaseRequest" has no @permission, so it asks the policy about the derived name "acme::purchasing.PurchaseRequest.submit", which changes if the transition is renamed. Declare @permission, or @public: true.
